tei:div.tei:p: 31) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi rtsa sgrub bar chad kun sel dngos grub bum bzang bzhugs: 32) na mo padma kā ra ye: gdod nas rnam dag chos kyi sku: lhun grub sku dang ye shes rdzogs: gang 'dul thugs rjes 'gro rnams 'dul: mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chad la 'dud: ma 'ongs snyigs ma snyigs ma'i dus: chos sgrub dman cing bdud bstan dar: du ru ka yis bod 'bangs phung: chos bzhin spyod pa nyin skar tsam: de phyir kho mo mtsho rgyal ngas: rjes 'jug skyes bu'i don ched du: zab sgrub bar chad kun sel bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: rtsa gsum kun 'dus rdo rje phur pa'i lhar: bdag sogs 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro rnams 33) sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: bdag gis smon 'jug byang chub sems bskyed do: lan gsum brjod: hūm̐: nga ni rig pa don gyi lha: gnyis snang 'khrul pa dbyings su bshig: mi shigs rdo rje srung ba'i gur: yongs grub chen por lhun gyis grub: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: hūm̐: sku gsum ye shes dkyil 'khor lha'i: dbang byin dngos grub byin chen phobs: snod bcud dag pa rab 'byams su: mchod pa'i rdzas su byin gyis rlobs: pheṃ dza a be sha ya a: ma hā sarba pū dza ho: sa ma ya 34)shuddha a: gnyis pa dngos gzhi lha bskyed ni: āḥ chos rnams rang bzhin rnam par dag: stong zhing bdag med de bzhin nyid: 'gags med rang gsal kun tu snang*/ thugs rje'i ye shes snying rje'i rtsal: rig pa rgyu yi yi ger shar: de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs ri rab dang: mi 'jig rdo rje'i brag chen steng: ye shes las grub srung gur dbus: hūm̐ las bhrūum̐ 'phros yongs gyur pa: rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa:

rang byung lhun grub chen por rdzogs: de dbus 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng: byol song gtso brgyad kyis btegs khrir: skyon bral pad zla nyi ma dang: log 'dren bdud bgegs bsnol ba'i steng: dbyings nas sa bon gdan la babs: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: rig pa chos nyid don gyi lha: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar dbus mthing g.yon zhal dmar: spyan dgu sdang mig g.yo zhing 'khrugs: zhal gdangs 35)ljags 'dril mche ba gtsig: sma ra smin mar me 'od 'phro: dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil: thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang: snyan gnyis nyi ma zla bas brgyan: phyag drug g.yas gnyis gser rdo rje: rtse dgu dang ni rtse lnga gdengs: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin: tha gnyis gnam lcags phur bu 'dreil: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor stabs mdzad: dur khrod dpal chas sku la rdzogs: ye shes me dpung 'khrigs pa'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med pa'o: sbyor yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: kha ṭwāṃ dang ni thod khrag 'dzin: spyan gsum sku gsum dbyings su gzigs: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril smar smin 'khyil: sku la khro mo'i chas kun rdzogs: zhabs g.yon yab kyi sku la 'khril: g.yas brkyangs ti ra'i gdan la brdzi: zhal sbyor drag po'i gad rgyangs sgrogs: gtso bo'i spyi bor bya khyung gi: rwa bar mi bskyod yab yum shar: gnas lnga rtsa yi 'khor lo ru: khrag 'thung kī la rigs lnga ni: zhal 36)gsum phyag drug khro chas rdzogs: sku smad phur bu'i dbal dang ldan: phyi rim gnam lcags rtsibs 'khor dang: gnyis snang bdud bgegs bsnol ba'i steng: sku gsung thugs las sprul pa yi: sras dang khro bcu za gsod dang: dbang phyug bstan ma ming sring tshogs: phur srung dam can rgya mtsho bcas: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por bskyed:

de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las: 'od 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba rnams: rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnam pa ru: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su sol: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med par: ro gcig chos sku'i klong du bzhugs: lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: mngon gyur chen por ye phyag 'tshal: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ tiṣṭha lhan: na mo hoḥ oṃ: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med rtsal: bkod pa rab 'byams mchod pa'i rdzas: yongs grub rig pa'i rgyan du shar: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: bzhes nas mchog gi dngos grub stsol: dzñā na ma hā sarba pañtsa pū dza khā hiḥ oṃ arghaṃ sogs phyi nang gsang mchod sbyor sgrol sngags kyis mchod: hūm̐: che ba'i 37)che mchog 'jigs byed he ru ka: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs gtum drag 'bar ba'i sku: bdud bgegs log 'dren ma lus 'dul mdzad pa: khro rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang: kī la rigs lnga sku gsung thugs kyi sras: khro bcu yab yum za gsod pho nya dang: dbang phyug bstan ma phur srung dam can sogs: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag nyid phur pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad mi 'byung zhing: bskyed rdzogs rim gnyis 'bras bu mthar son nas: 'pho med phyag rgya chen po'i sku 'grub shog: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' chon gang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril bsnol stabs su 'dzin cing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs yi thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gyen bslang du khod pa'i lte bar nyi zla'i gā'u kha sbyor gyi nang du thugs srog hūm̐ yig mthing nag gi mthar gsang ba'i snying po 'bru dgus g.yas su bskor bar bsgom la: hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs ka ru: ye shes sems dpa' rgyan med 'od phung 'bar: thugs kar nyi steng gnam lcags

38)kyi: rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte ba ru: nyi zla'i gā'u kha sbyor dbus: thugs srog hūm̐ yig mtha' bskor du: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus srog gi snying por bstim: gtso 'khor srog sngags ro gcig gyur: bzlas pas snod bcud gnyis snang sems: mnyam rdzogs mnyam nyid chos sku'i ngang: ma bcos bde ba chan por āḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐: smra bcad mi tshig ma 'dres par: bye ba bzlas pas dngos grub thob: sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pas dbye: gsang zhing gsang bar nyams blang na: phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad sel: khyad par du ru kha dar dus: snyigs ma snyigs ma'i rang rtags ngoms: chos bzhin spyod pa'i skyes bu la: log pa bdud kyi bar chad sdang: brten pa'i lha srung gshed du babs: legs pa ltar snang 'gal rkyen bskul: chos bzhin spyad kyang chos min gol: de'i tshe gdams pa 'di nyid ni: yal bar ma dor nyams blang na: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal bar nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: chos 'di'i bka' yi gnyer 'dzin pa: gnod sbyin gza' dang ma mor gtad: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 39)'phrad: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gu hyaḥbarda thim: : ces pa 'di yang rang slob dam pa khams ri bo rtse'i grwa tshang bkra shis tshe ring dang*/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ 'gyur med tshul khrims/ gsam gtan rgya mtsho sogs kyis reg bya nam mkha'i mdangs bcas zab gter yongs rdzogs bebs dgos zhes lan grangs du mar nan cher bskul ba dang*/ dge btsun mgon brtan nas kyang yang yang bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du/ su kha badzra ming gis nyam chos yig ris su bris pa'o// 40)
